2.251.10
MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons element specifies a collection of embedded map polygons.
This element is optional. This element is of type MapPolygons.
Following is the parent element of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons element.
Parent elements
MapPolygonLayer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons element.
 <xsd:element name="MapPolygons" type="MapPolygonsType" minOccurs="0" />
